DESCRIPTION.general: Required dictionary of warning thresholds, command timeout and kernel message limit.
DESCRIPTION.general.temperature_warning: Required. Temperature in degrees Celsius at which a detected sensor is reported as WARNING.
DESCRIPTION.general.memory_usage_warning: Required. Memory usage percentage at which system RAM usage is reported as WARNING.
DESCRIPTION.general.command_timeout: Required finite positive number of seconds for lscpu, lspci, lsusb and dmesg. File-based checks do not use this timeout.
DESCRIPTION.general.kernel_error_limit: Required positive integer limiting the most recent non-empty kernel error messages returned by dmesg; message order is preserved.
DESCRIPTION.cpu.fields: Required dictionary of lscpu source names to display labels, both strings. Insertion order controls output order. Missing source fields are omitted; an empty mapping is permitted.
